text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you going to replace the top lift? 
If you leave it like that, the heel base 
will get damaged too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If we repair it, it'll last for a while 
longer.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Good items that last a long time are ones 
that are treated with care.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sure it will serve you well 
whenever you use it."
